description: Uses the Mac's mouse and keyboard, then answers with a new screenshot. Points are pixels of the screenshot from computer_look. action: click (x, y; button right, count 2 for a double click), move (x, y), drag (x, y to to_x, to_y), scroll (x, y, direction, amount in lines), type (text, where the keyboard focus is), key (keys like return, escape, cmd+c, cmd+shift+4), open_app (name). With app: press (ref from computer_look ui with that app), type (text; with ref, into that field, only once it has the keyboard focus), choose (ref of a dropdown, option: the choice's name), and key go to that app only, in the background, without the pointer or the front; the answer says the field's value and anything else in the window that changed, with a picture of the window; prefer this whenever the task is in one app. Clicks, moves, drags, and scrolls at a point use the real pointer, so leave app out for those.

app.description: Act on this app in the background (press, type, key, choose)

keys.description: For key: the key, with modifiers joined by +

machine.description: The machine to use, by name, as the machines tool lists it. Leave it out when only one machine offers this tool.

option.description: For choose: the choice's name, as the dropdown shows it

ref.description: For press, choose, or type into a field: the reference from computer_look ui

name: computer_act
title: Use the Mouse and Keyboard
